text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, this seems to be the conclusion.
Whether the 'Genesis Method' hits the mark or not...
I have to see every race tomorrow through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"According to this morning's weather forecast, it'll be sunny tomorrow...
I'm sure the track will be firm—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Huh... The forecast changed...?!
Rainclouds suddenly formed, making it a 100% chance of rain...
Then all my predictions for the races are...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
In that case, I'll just have to rethink my plan!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"If the track turns heavy, that Umamusume
should have a solid shot...
I don't think I'll be able to sleep tonight until I've predicted every outcome."
